title: NL & NH model connection overview
caption: High-level connection overview for the standard NL Series (230V→230V) and NH Series (460V→460V) rotary phase converters. Shows L1/L2 input, capacitor bank, contactor path, and T1/T2/T3 output routing to your equipment. (Manual p. 11)

title: GP100NL 100 HP configuration
caption: Full internal wiring for the flagship GP100NL. Note the multiple parallel run capacitors used to hold voltage balance across a 100 HP idler under load. (Manual p. 12)

title: NL Model 40 terminal block connections (L3, L2, L1)
caption: Terminal-block detail for the GP40NL. Use this diagram when landing your input feeder wires — pay close attention to the L3 terminal position, which is unique to certain revisions. (Manual p. 13)

title: GP40NL original wiring diagram
caption: Original-revision GP40NL wiring, applicable to both NL and NH configurations. If your GP40NL was shipped before 2022 and does not match the page 5 layout, use this diagram. (Manual p. 14)

title: NLA / AutoLink compressor duty wiring
caption: AutoLink wiring for a compressor-duty installation. AutoLink prevents the compressor from restarting simultaneously with the converter after a power interruption — the #1 cause of overcurrent trips on compressor circuits. (Manual p. 15)

title: PL & PH model connection overview
caption: High-level overview for PL Series (230V→230V, front start/stop) and PH Series (460V→460V, front start/stop). The T1/T2 timer terminals for the start/stop control circuit are shown. (Manual p. 16)

title: PL model panel layout and connections
caption: Physical panel layout of a PL rotary. Use this diagram to identify each component during any panel inspection: contactor, start caps, run caps, voltage relay, distribution block, and terminal strip. (Manual p. 17)

title: PL model detailed internal wiring
caption: Internal wire routing for the PL series. Every color-coded wire, terminal number, and jumper is shown. (Manual p. 18)

title: PL model complete wiring with notes
caption: PL complete wiring including installer notes on wire sizing, torque values, and the small-diameter jumper wire that ties the timer circuit to the contactor coil. (Manual p. 19)

title: PL & PH full schematic
caption: Full electrical schematic (not physical layout) for the PL/PH series. Use this diagram when troubleshooting circuits by function rather than by physical location. (Manual p. 20)

title: PLT & PLTA transformer configurations
caption: Both transformer-package configurations shown side by side. PLT uses an external fusable disconnect between converter and transformer; PLTA integrates the AutoLink system for lockout protection during power interruptions. (Manual p. 21)

title: PLTA AutoLink transformer package
caption: Complete wiring for a PLTA installation. The AutoLink block sits between the 230V three-phase output of the converter and the 460V input of the step-up transformer, preventing simultaneous reenergization after utility restoration. (Manual p. 22)

title: NH model 340V panel layout and motor connection
caption: NH panel layout showing the 340V tap arrangement and motor connections. NH-Series converters take a 460V single-phase input; internal jumpers select the correct capacitor voltage rating. (Manual p. 23)

title: NH 460V complete high-voltage wiring
caption: Full NH high-voltage wiring at 460V input. All conductors, capacitors, and contactor coils are rated for the higher operating voltage. (Manual p. 24)

title: PH model 340V panel layout and connections
caption: PH-series panel layout with the front-panel start/stop button wired into the 340V tap configuration. (Manual p. 25)

title: PH 460V start/stop wiring
caption: Complete PH high-voltage wiring at 460V input including start/stop control circuit and timer. (Manual p. 26)

title: DualZone schematic and PL configuration wiring
caption: DualZone overall electrical schematic combined with the PL-style start/stop control circuit. Shows how the two idler motors share a single control panel while each receives its own dedicated capacitor bank. (Manual p. 27)

title: DualZone dual idler motor terminal connections
caption: Physical terminal connections for both idler motors in a DualZone unit. Motor 1 handles the base load; Motor 2 auto-cycles in when the current draw exceeds the base-load threshold. (Manual p. 28)

title: Idler motor cutaway (internal components)
caption: Cutaway of a three-phase idler motor showing rotor, stator, windings, bearings, cooling fan, and terminal box. Reference this diagram anytime you need to identify the internal component causing noise, vibration, or heat. (Manual p. 29)

title: 9-lead and 12-lead motor wiring (230V and 460V)
caption: Standard 9-lead and 12-lead three-phase motor wiring for low-voltage (230V) and high-voltage (460V) connections. This is the diagram you need when landing the T1/T2/T3 output from a Phoenix converter into your three-phase load motor. (Manual p. 30)

title: Application wiring notes (multi-machine, sub-panels)
caption: Application-specific wiring notes and common installation configurations. Includes multi-machine shop wiring, sub-panel feeds, and equipment-specific power routing. (Manual p. 31)
